# Soil Health Model (Synthetic)

This directory contains a tabular soil-health model (XGBoost).

**IMPORTANT:** This model is trained on **synthetic data** generated by heuristic rules for demonstration purposes.
It does not represent real-world agricultural validation and must not be used to make actual fertilizer dosage claims.

Run `python train.py` to generate the synthetic data and the `soil_model_synthetic.pkl` file used for demo inference.
